style.backgroundSystem: alternating graphite dark studio panels and light grey or white studio panels, clean depth, no busy textures

style.lockText: consistent industrial electrical ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of graphite dark background #17181C, mist light grey #F2F4F6, pure white #FFFFFF, and one industrial yellow accent #F5C400; neutral temperature, crisp cool studio lighting; modern geometric sans-serif headlines with short copy; rounded dark info cards with thin-line white icons in dark circular chips; clean commercial product photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; stable product scale and every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.
style.presentationRules: stable slight 3/4 hero angle, product centered or right-anchored, consistent scale across the set, each screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins

style.typography: modern geometric sans-serif; Chinese in-image text wrapped in 「」, headline 28-48pt, label 10-14pt, short copy only
